ModMetaData.name: French Grammar Renew - Pickle tests
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
In-game functional tests for French Grammar Renew, run by Pickle. Development only: never published.
Seven features: the mod loading, its patches installed and its texts present; the French corrections applied by the patched language worker of a running game; English isolation; the settings page and its hidden shortcut (captured, tagged @review); a two-launch restart test of the saved settings; and, in the RIMMSQOL pass only, RIMMSQOL revealing and hiding the shortcut. They need the companion steps assembly built from Tests/Pickle/Source against Mod/Assemblies/FrenchGrammarPlus.dll. See TESTING.md at the repository root for the passes and Tests/Pickle/README.md for what is deliberately left out.
